title: Methods
explain: A method has a return type, a name and typed parameters, and `void` means it returns nothing. Java passes arguments by value, so changing a parameter inside a method does not change the caller's variable. Methods with the same name but different parameters are overloaded.
exercise: Write `max(int a, int b, int c)` and test it with the three numbers in different orders.
tip: Reassigning a parameter never changes the caller's variable. To change an object, call a method on the object instead.
